profile.name: 参数控制模块
profile.description: 用于实验控制软件中管理参数、响应设置变更，并通过 TCP/IP 或 LECO 与远端仪器或服务通信的通用控制模块。本证据不足以对应到某一台明确的物理实验设备。
profile.description_en: A general control module used in laboratory control software to manage parameters, react to setting changes, and communicate with remote instruments or services over TCP/IP or LECO. The evidence does not support identification of a specific physical laboratory device.
